verdict.rationale: Asana documents its own headless interface: a token-authenticated REST API, official JavaScript and Python client libraries, and webhooks, which together let scripts and automation jobs act on Asana without the UI. Nothing in the evidence shows a CLI, CI integration guidance, or service-account patterns for running it in pipelines, so the headless/CI part is only implied by the API. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI-runner tooling, documented CI/headless usage guidance, non-interactive service-account auth docs, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Learn to create and authorize with a token then create tasks via the API.
